label: A distinct cause of a thing's being is more in being than it
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: whatever, distinct from x, causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse, CAUSE_2 at esse) is more in being than x (MoreIn esse c x). It is the instance at esse of the formal reading STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH (same MoreIn; registered strength order, strict in control 1: it says nothing about causes of perfections other than being); the synonymous source sense of Metaphysics alpha is not claimed at esse. The order model of MoreIn esse is open (STMT-ATTRIBUTION-ORDER-RESTRICTS-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH). It is derived from 'Whatever causes the being of anything is itself in act as to being' and the reception bundle at esse, with no transfer principle, so it does not rest on 'nothing gives what it does not have' or q.4 a.2 preexistence. It constrains only distinct causes of being; instruments and causes of becoming are not causes of being on the reading of DISAMB-BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE and fall outside it on that open bridge reading. 'More in being' is the primitive MoreIn at esse (DEF-MORE-IN); its link to InAct is only through STMT-MORE-SUCH-HAS-THE-PERFECTION and STMT-UNLIMITED-POSSESSION-EXCEEDS-LIMITED. An equal-grade cause of being (a cause of another's being that is not more in being than it) would falsify it; the univocal generation case (man begets man) is a cause of becoming on that reading, so it is not a counterexample unless parents are causes of being (open bridge). No independent warrant is recorded beyond its derivation from open premises.
